audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2 and 3 are marked Singed while their own whys say Kled's burst 'outpaces your W+E kit' and 'the duel is still net-negative'. Level 6 is marked Skill while its why calls it your clearest kill window all game, and the first-item row is marked Singed while its why says the 1v1 is 'genuinely even'.
audit.why: Kled mounted at 2-3 has a hook, an attack-speed burst and a dash against a Singed with no items; Singed's real spikes are level 1 (before the hook matters) and level 6 with Ghost.
audit.corrected: Singed / Kled / Kled / Skill / Singed / Skill / Singed — the packet chart, and the one the whys already describe.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 kill window is gated on 'Skaarl's Screech being on cooldown'. There is no such ability.
audit.why: Kled's kit is Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard (P), Bear Trap on a Rope (Q), Violent Tendencies (W), Jousting (E) and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R). 'Skaarl's Screech' is invented, and it is the trigger the page hangs your best window on — a player waiting for it waits forever. The real gate is Jousting at 13/12/11/10/9s, which is both his escape and his re-engage.
audit.corrected: Commit at 6 when Jousting is down — or simply drop Mega Adhesive first, because grounded he cannot cast it at all.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Mega Adhesive grounds, and both of Kled's mobility tools — Jousting (E) and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R) — are dashes. The page instead tells you to Fling 'before he can turn Jousting into an escape', which is a timing race you do not need to run.
audit.why: Riot Mega Adhesive: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' Riot Jousting: 'Kled dashes... Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target.' Riot Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 'Kled and Skaarl charge to a location.' Grounding removes both the escape and the re-engage, and Fling landing him back in the puddle roots him on top of that. Also unstated: Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset (kit autoReset flag) — the four-attack wind-up is the tell to step off.
audit.corrected: Goo first, Fling second. Grounded Kled cannot Jousting out and cannot Chaaaaaaaarge!!! away; the Fling landing roots him in the poison.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Q is called 'Beartrap on a Rope' throughout both layers; the real name is 'Bear Trap on a Rope'. spikes[1] also says he can 'proc Skaarl's dismount' against you — the dismount happens to Kled when Skaarl's health runs out, not to his target.
audit.why: Riot Bear Trap on a Rope: 'Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled', 11/10/9/8/7s. Riot Skaarl: 'When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.'
audit.corrected: Spelling fixed and the shackle-then-yank described as it actually works.

edits.before: Run Poison Trail through the wave — Kled's Beartrap on a Rope misses if you're already behind him, and his passive courage meter can't build without you standing still.
edits.after: Run Poison Trail through the wave — Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope misses if you're already behind him, and Skaarl's courage cannot build while you refuse to stand still.

edits.before: Kled's Beartrap + Violent Tendencies burst is his kill window — if he roots you in Beartrap, he chains full Q dismount damage and can proc Skaarl's dismount at level 3.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope, 11s at rank 1, is his kill window — the shackle yanks you back to him and Violent Tendencies' four fast attacks are where the damage actually lives.

edits.before: Use Insanity Potion plus ghost at level 6 to run at Kled the instant Skaarl's Screech is on cooldown, when he can't redirect your Fling
edits.after: Use Insanity Potion plus Ghost at 6 and lead with Mega Adhesive — grounded, Kled cannot Jousting out or Chaaaaaaaarge!!! away

edits.before: At levels 4 and 5 you start the proxy pattern — farm behind his tower or cut the side wave so he has to decide between following you (and eating poison for free) or letting the minions cannon through. Kled hates chasing Singed because Poison Trail does its best work on champions who run after you, and his courage mechanics actively punish him for backing off a fight he started. Level 6 is your breakout: pop Insanity Potion the instant Skaarl's Screech is on cooldown, ghost straight at him, and Fling him behind you into Mega Adhesive before he can turn Jousting into an escape. A rooted, dismounted Kled sitting in your goo has maybe two seconds of HP — the poison plus your AP burst finishes him before Skaarl re-mounts. This is your clearest kill window all game; bank it every time Screech is down.
edits.after: At levels 4 and 5 you start the proxy pattern — farm behind his tower or cut the side wave so he has to decide between following you (and eating poison for free) or letting the minions cannon through. Kled hates chasing Singed because Poison Trail does its best work on champions who run after you, and his courage mechanics actively punish him for backing off a fight he started. Level 6 is your breakout, and the order is what makes it work: Insanity Potion, Ghost in, Mega Adhesive under his feet, then Fling. Grounded, he cannot Jousting out and cannot Chaaaaaaaarge!!! away, and the Fling landing roots him in the goo. A dismounted Kled stuck in poison has about two seconds of HP, and the burn finishes him long before Skaarl re-mounts. Bank that window every single time.

edits.before: Insanity Potion's movement speed and armor make you tanky enough to run through Jousting and Fling a dismounted Kled into Mega Adhesive for the kill.
edits.after: Insanity Potion's speed and stats let you reach him, and Mega Adhesive grounds Jousting outright — goo first, then Fling the dismounted Kled back into it.

edits.before: Proxy + kite — don’t get pulled, fling his dismount. Singed wins the Beartrap on a Rope cooldown windows.
edits.after: Proxy + kite — goo grounds Jousting, then fling his dismount into it. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your breakout at 6: Insanity Potion, Ghost, goo, Fling. Grounded he cannot Jousting out, and the landing roots him in the poison.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Keep moving. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope 11/10/9/8/7s: the hook that starts everything — keep moving sideways. - Jousting 13-9s is his escape, and Mega Adhesive grounds it off entirely. - Insanity Potion 100s: kill windows only.

notes: 'Skaarl's Screech' is a fabricated ability and appeared twice (wants.you[2], mid) as the trigger for the level-6 kill window — both removed. 'Beartrap on a Rope' (one word) is the wrong spelling and is baked into focus.text, loading, dosFull[0].t, report[5].t, winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.difficulty and several phase whys as well; I fixed the instances I was already rewriting. 'Chaaaaarge!!!' in late and whys[6] is also short by three a's versus Riot's 'Chaaaaaaaarge!!!' — worth a global string replace rather than per-matchup edits.
